blurb: Guests climb indoors on walls with required climbing shoes and harnesses. The gym offers memberships, day passes, youth and adult climbing programs, corporate team building packages, and outdoor climbing instruction. Certified staff provide lessons and belay tests are required for top-rope and lead climbing.
